items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: let's use Dick Jurgens's drummer with the bass

ctx.x: Aragon Ballroom, big band. So they wanted to have a battle of the bands with Ina's band when it come through. And I went through and I said, I'll fix it. So I wrote Ina's two or three arrangements and I said, give me one of yours, and I took Ina's arrangements and I made another part of each part. Said, now I want the reed section to set like this, a boy and a girl, a boy and a girl, big stage. I said, the boys can sit a little behind.

I said, now, the two drums we can't use, but we'll use -- let's use Dick Jurgens's drummer with the bass, and the girl -- no, wait, I let the girl play the bass drum and I let him play without the bass. And that's what they called a double band, and they hadn't had that before, see, Stanley. So you know they had a good band when I took one of his girls because they read what they see. They could read what they see, and I knew the arrangements.
Well, now, when you say they were very popular, was it because they were girls or was it because they were --
